title: Silas and the Room
author: Zephyrine Voss
blurb: Astrid Coldharbour, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
